==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I discover an arcade machine. It prompts me to choose between two options, but only one option is visible. I choose the only option I can see, but somehow it triggers the invisible second option.

The arcade cabinet prints out an iridescent orange card. I plug the card into a different machine. This activates a cyber portal that pulls me into a game world.

Inside the game, I am an alien with a laser blaster. I am battling off against swarms of hyper intelligent bugs. It is unclear if I am meant to be a hero or not.
